blocks.text: Arnold Clavio filed a cyberlibel complaint against Mario Ceniza Jr. the alleged bodyguard of former House Speaker Zaldy Co, who alleged that the veteran news anchor and host were among those who received money from anomalous flood control projects. Ceniza was among those who attended a June 2026 press conference organized by former Anakalusugan Rep. Mike Defensor, where he accused several personalities, including media figures and celebrities, of benefiting from the alleged scam. Among those he named was Clavio, whom he claimed to have delivered cash to in a brown paper bag. Clavio has denied the allegations. On Wednesday, Oct. 14, […]...
